technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the library in Go, consistent with Hyperledger Fabric's ecosystem.
Use the existing Hyperledger Fabric SDK Go libraries for protobuf and configuration handling.
Design functions to accept and return ConfigEnvelope and ConfigUpdateEnvelope structures.
Follow the existing channel update tutorial patterns for modifying configurations.
Use GoDoc-compatible comments for all exported functions and types.
Implement certificate validation using standard Go crypto libraries.
Structure the library to support both adding and removing anchor peers through a unified interface.
Use the existing MSP configuration structures from the Fabric protobuf definitions.
assumptions: The developer has prior experience with Hyperledger Fabric and Go development.
The necessary Hyperledger Fabric dependencies and tools are already installed.
The library will be implemented as a standalone package that can be imported by other projects.
The example tests will be written using the standard Go testing framework.
The certificate revocation functionality will only modify the revocation_list field in the MSP config.
The orderer configuration retrieval will return a copy of the configuration to prevent unintended mutations.
The anchor peer retrieval function will return a list of anchor peers for a given organization.
The library will not include a full signature workflow implementation, only the ability to generate config updates ready for signing.

activities.activity_name: Analyze specification and design library structure
activities.activity_description: Review the user stories and design the overall structure of the library, including package layout, function signatures, and data flow.
Create functions to add an anchor peer to an existing channel configuration and generate a ConfigUpdate transaction.
Create functions to remove an anchor peer from an existing channel configuration and generate a ConfigUpdate transaction.
Create a function to revoke a certificate by modifying the revocation_list attribute of the MSP configuration.

activities.activity_name: Implement root CA certificate addition functionality
activities.activity_description: Create a function to add a new root CA certificate to an MSP configuration with minimal validation.
Create a function to retrieve existing anchor peers for a specific organization from the configuration.
Create a function to retrieve orderer configuration and a function to update it.
